summary: Octave Intelligence plc filed an 8-K reporting completion of its spin-off from Hexagon AB via a pro-rata distribution of Octave shares to Hexagon holders. Effective May 22, 2026, each holder of Hexagon Class A/B shares received 1 Octave Class A/B share for every 10 Hexagon shares held. Octave entered spin-related agreements including the Distribution, Tax Disaffiliation, Employee Matters, Master Transition Services, and Registration Rights Agreements. Octave shares are delivered as Swedish Depository Receipts. No price, premium, or advisor is named. This is a completed tax-free distribution. Watch for post-issuance trading dynamics and potential index inclusion or selling pressure from Hexagon shareholders unfamiliar with Octave.
